## Install

- Linux `.deb`: use the `.deb` asset on Debian/Ubuntu-based systems.
- Linux AppImage: download, mark executable and run.
- Windows: use the MSI.
- macOS: open the DMG and move Llama Player to Applications.

## Update

This build is signed for Tauri Updater. Test update from the previous version before publishing this draft.
